name: Nittoc Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: Nittoc Construction Co., Ltd. engages in construction works in Japan. The company is involved in civil engineering, carpentry, construction, scaffolding and earthwork, masonry, roofing, electrical construction, pipe construction, steel structure construction, paving, dredging, painting, waterproofing, interior finishing, landscaping, demolition, and well drilling activities, as well as tile, brick, and block construction. The company also engages in foundation works, including foundation treatment for dams, ground improvement, slop protection, and repair works; civil engineering; geological surveys and surveying; and other related activities.
